findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body: For any request where `userTenant !== documentTenant`, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`. This removes the function’s existing tenant boundary and permits cross-tenant document access. Restore the tenant comparison or an equivalent authorization check.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document access checks
findings.body:
When `userTenant !== documentTenant`, the function now returns `true`, allowing every cross-tenant user to read documents outside their tenant.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation before granting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any call with `userTenant !== documentTenant` permits cross-tenant document access, bypassing the function’s authorization boundary.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
